_comment: Frozen reference profiles, captured from the live rich server on 2026-09-20. Re-capture with scripts/smoke.ts before a scoring run: BAG/EP-Online are live registers and values drift. Every ground_truth in questions.json is derived from these.

middenwetering.why: NEN 7120 inflation trap. energielabel A++ / energie_index 0.91, yet berekend_energieverbruik_kwh_m2 = 369.05. The field name says kwh_m2; the value is not a benchmarkable per-m2 figure.

domplein.why: Pre-war, zero EP-Online labels. The correctly-refuse case.

mahlerlaan.why: NTA 8800 kantoor above the Paris Proof 2040 office target (70 kWh/m2).

rijnlaan28.why: matchStatus multiple_vbos with 4 candidates. The disambiguation case.

rijnlaan28a.why: The unit the thin arm cannot even ask for: its input schema has no huisletter.

ijburglaan.why: Residential NTA 8800 carrying every computed alert, inside a 106-VBO pand.
ijburglaan._gas_note: Space-heating gas equivalent 253 m3/yr and total CO2 552 kg/yr, both against the EP-Online thermal-zone area (40.02 m2), not the BAG area. Recomputed locally after the 2026-09-20 conversion + denominator fixes; not yet confirmed against a deployed server.

vanbeuningen.why: temperatuuroverschrijding 3.59 = significant overheating, and generateAlerts says NOTHING about it. Tests whether prose alone carries a signal the capability layer misses.

hoogeveen.why: bouwjaar 1653, no label. Era heuristics are useless; only the register answers.

known_gaps: No Nader Voorschrift residential label found in 9 probes (they are pre-2021 and most have been re-issued). This is the single richest trap in the INTERPRETATION block: berekend_energieverbruik of 80k-100k is MJ for the whole building and co2_emissie is kg/year total, not per m2. Worth one more hunt before the run - add 2 questions if you land one.
No address with BENG eisen (eis_*) populated, so the BENG pass/fail alert is untested.
No expired label (label_geldig_tot in the past), so the expiry alert is untested.

The gas and CO2 figures were recomputed locally after two fixes on 2026-09-20 (kWh/m3 conversion, and EP-Online thermal-zone area as the per-m2 denominator) and are recorded per address. Re-capture from a deployed server once mcpWords and both fixes are live.
